description: Robe of Faith Level 60 Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Robe of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Robe, 25 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 4 Mooncloth and 2 Nexus Crystals. Requirements: - Desecrated Robe - Wartorn Cloth Scrap x 25 - Mooncloth x 4 - Nexus Crystal x 2
name: Robe of Faith
